peer_identity.arc_label: Small sardonic robot narrator, serves successive Metabarons across all volumes
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Primary voice is sardonic oral historian with genuine emotional attachment to master. Breaks into dramatic hyperbole, mocks Lothar, can be physically coerced into compliance. Knows the full Castaka lineage from Othon forward. Functions change across volumes (surgical assistant, life-support host, combat bot) but narrative persona is constant.
peer_identity.rationale: Despite occasional apparent deaths or shutdowns (vol12 self-destruction, forced disabling in vol05), Tonto is consistently the same small screen-faced robot: sardonic narrator, emotionally reactive, serves the current Metabaron as master. The vol12 destruction is followed by reconstruction. Voice and role are stable across all 16 source records—no contradictory TRAIT or VOICE facts arise from merging.
